name: com.atommerce.maca_android_sdk.ui.view.main.view.MyCouponActivity
description: When the user opens My Coupons in the Mindcafe Android SDK from Atommerce, it loads saved coupons and lets the user register a coupon code. Selecting a coupon can continue to the counselors who accept it.
disableEffect: Users cannot view or register coupons here, or continue from a coupon to an eligible counselor.
